title: What a learner product shows, normalized for the quality contract
description: An extractor reads a delivered product (HTML pages, a PDF, Markdown) and records only what the learner can see or do: blocks of text, figures and when they appear, attempt controls, reveals and whether they are gated, support levels and provenance, and page shell facts. Shared/tools/quality_contract.py judges this record against Shared/quality/learner-quality.v1.json. Subject-neutral: subjects differ only in the vocabulary of figure kinds and check types (<Subject>/adapter/QualityVocabulary.json).

observed_by.description: Extractor id (Shared/tools/quality_observe.py) or 'fixture' for hand-built samples.

render_stamp.description: Stamp the governed renderer writes (records digest); null when absent.

escape_states.description: Escape-state tokens (HOLD, BLOCKED, …) presented to the learner as an outcome.

roles_rendered.description: Core roles actually rendered as learner pages. Omit when the observation covers only part of a product.

roles_expected.description: Core roles the product manifest explicitly declares for delivery. Absent preserves the legacy all-six-role expectation.

from_page.description: Printed from the rendered page (not a separate generator).

shell.description: Null when the observation is not of a web page (a print reference, a sample unit).

rendered.description: Facts only a browser can measure (tools/site-audit/core-page-audit.mjs). Null when not measured; rules that need them are then skipped and reported as NOT_MEASURED.

kind.description: Representation kind from the subject's QualityVocabulary (null when the page does not say).

stages_total.description: Stages the representation has in all; reveal_stages is how many are shown here.

representation_ref.description: The representation this figure mounts (null when the page does not say).

mount.description: The construction unit or question the figure is staged for (Core1A unit id, or the question itself).

stages_in_dom.description: Stage groups actually present in the figure's markup (hidden ones included). A pre-attempt figure must carry no more than it shows.

asset_text.description: The figure's SVG carries its asset's own <title> or <desc>, which describe the whole figure, result included.

caption_source.description: Where the figure's caption comes from: the shown stages' labels, or the representation's design purpose (which may name the result). Null when the page does not say.

blocks.description: Contract block id -> the learner-visible text of that block. A block that is absent is not a key.

block_order.description: Block ids in the order the learner meets them.

placeholders.description: Placeholder or internal-absence text shown to the learner.

representation_refs_unmounted.description: Representations named in the text but not shown.

attempt.description: The learner has a control to record an attempt or commitment.

gated.description: Cannot be opened before an attempt is recorded.

support_levels.description: Ordered support rungs (hints/scaffolds), least to most.

components.description: Blueprint components the page marks (data-g9-component): which one, how many items it holds, and for a per-unit component the construction unit it belongs to.

waived.description: Expected components the record's author declared not applicable: component id (suffixed @unit for a per-unit component) to the reason written in the record.

support_rows.description: Typed support custody observed from renderer data-g9-support-* markers. Optional for legacy calibration observations; render_core observations always emit it, including an empty array.

decisions.description: Distinct decisions/events in the unit's construction.

prerequisites_bridged.description: Assumed prerequisites that link to a teaching unit.

metadata.description: Learner-visible canonical metadata items observed from data-g9-meta-* markers. Optional for legacy calibration observations; render_core observations always emit the field.
